scoring.point_opacity: arithmetic mean of four sigmoid opacities for each candidate

a.name: 앞 후보만
a.change: Keep only four Gaussians of larger normal height per point; absent candidate opacity is zero in summaries.

b.name: 색 먼저 맞추기
b.change: Opacity fixed for updates 1..1000, enabled for updates 1001..4000; same seed-zero sequence continued.

c.name: 모양 학습
c.change: Train candidate means, raw quaternions and log inplane scales; clamp means to own normal-height +/-1.96 sigma and tangent coordinates +/-0.25m after each update.
c.prior_sigma_rule: Appendix C; median finite raw u_prior for ALS; same-surface roof type for LoD2
c.missing_sigma: Stop only arm c for affected case; no imputation

d.name: 둘레 장면 학습
d.change: Train only opacity/DC/SH of background centers within XY 3m of any original place point; background geometry and all other values fixed.

representative_rule: Reuse first three v1 representatives. New B173_LoD2 uses the exact v1 representative() rule restricted to group a/front; maximize point count then area then lexical seed ID.

depth.source: GeoGS-conf-guided-v1-r18 arguments depth_ratio=0.0; gaussian_renderer surf_depth=sum(weight*ray-splat depth)/alpha; mesh_utils uses surf_depth
depth.per_point: Pool equally weighted valid pixels across three largest native-support training views; median height along original point normal.
depth.selection: Native v1 opacity-one candidate contributor IDs intersected with frozen v1 union mask; count unique point-pixel pairs, rank count descending then view name.
depth.invalid: No finite positive rendered depth or fewer than three nonempty views retained as unavailable, never zero.

photo.range: abs(h)<=DL_point; DL_point=median finite JUDGENUM base DL_cm of owned source patches divided by 100
photo.competition: outside range AND (inherited local maximum OR abs(h)>DL_point+0.3m)
photo.selection: Reuse JUDGENUM-v1 analysis_core.select/summaries and frozen base judgment_after, 135 choices, ties, building equal and leave-one-out; no new geometry or images
photo.stored_precision: Use stored float16 curves promoted to float32, preserve all other derive() operations; compare old-range replay with stored judgments and disclose precision differences.
photo.holdout: All detailed values only /out/holdout; public counts, areas and SHA-256 only
